New in this build:
- Untouched sounds stay untouched: opening the sampler or switching an envelope on no longer changes a sound until you turn a knob, and multisampled acoustic drums keep their velocity layers.
- Volume knobs are bigger and run from -12 dB (50%) at the bottom, through 0 dB at 12 o'clock, to +12 dB (200%) at the top.
- Sound library: every stock sound sits in the section of its original folder (kicks with kicks, 808s with 808s). Imported kits sort themselves into those sections. CLOSED HAT is now HI HATS in the track menu.
- Modern Black faceplate is smooth black metal again.
Please try: open a track's sample editor on an acoustic kit and play it, then turn one envelope knob and listen for only that change. Turn a volume knob from bottom to top.
